name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.character_sign
statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z = 1 ∨ M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z = -1
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
guidance: Unfold quotient value and binary character. Each bitSign is a power of -1, hence their product is ±1. Preserve dimension zero and its empty product. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.
